# 2 Baruch Chapter 18 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** First Fast and Vision

---

**1** The Lord said to me: "Listen to me, Baruch. I am going to speak to you, and you need to take what I say to heart.

**2** Yes, Adam was the first to sin, and he brought premature death on everyone. But among all those born after him, each person has been responsible for preparing his own suffering — and likewise, each person has chosen for himself the glory that is coming. Because the one who truly believes will certainly receive his reward."

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic rendering. "Premature death" for "untimely death." The key individual-responsibility theology rendered clearly: Adam = death comes to all; but each person = each chooses their own end. "Truly believes" for "assuredly he who believes."*
